sources.title: Intent Classifier — NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint
sources.snippet: Rather than using separate classifiers for intent and depth, the Intent Classifier combines all routing decisions into a single LLM invocation. This minimizes latency for the common case (meta queries get an instant response) and avoids an extra round-trip for research queries.
